1	# Round 6a: delete and undo for medications and lab results (logic round)
2	Owner decisions 2026-11-02: permanent delete after a confirmation dialog, then an Undo bar for about 8 seconds (afterwards gone for good). "Save and next" in the medication editor also offers Undo (removes only that medication). Applies to medications now and lab results with the same code path. UI (dialog, bar, delete buttons) is a separate design round; this round is model/state/storage only. Risk level 3 (data schema / clinical records): frontier-tier review and independent test review required.
3	
4	## Items
5	D600 `ClinicalRecordKind`: add MEDICATION_DELETE, MEDICATION_RESTORE, LAB_DELETE, LAB_RESTORE.
6	D601 `DeleteMedicationCommand(editorSessionId="", operationUuid, patientId, expectedPatientRevision, medicationId, expectedMedicationRevision, deletedContentHash)`: recordId = medicationId; fingerprint "MED_DEL|op|pid|pRev|medId|medRev|hash"; valid only if uuid valid, ids non-blank, both revisions >= 1, hash is 64 hex chars.
7	D602 `RestoreMedicationCommand(operationUuid, patientId, expectedPatientRevision, record: DemoMedicationRecord, sourceDelete: DeleteMedicationCommand)`: recordId = record.id; fingerprint "MED_RES|op|pid|pRev|" + sourceDelete fingerprint + "|" + canonical(record).
8	D603 Lab twins `DeleteLabInvestigationCommand`, `RestoreLabInvestigationCommand` (prefixes LAB_DEL, LAB_RES).
9	D604 `medicationContentHash(DemoMedicationRecord)` and `labContentHash(DemoLabInvestigation)`: sha256 of a pipe-joined canonical string of every field except revision, same field order as the existing MED/LAB fingerprints. Changing any field changes the hash; the revision does not.
10	D605 Revision rules: record at revision r. Delete removes the row and writes a receipt with committedRevision r+1 (tombstone). Restore re-inserts the same id and fields with revision r+2. Reject REVISION_EXHAUSTED if r >= Long.MAX_VALUE-1.
11	D606 Repository `execute` gets four branches with the same guards as saveMedication (PATIENT_NOT_FOUND, PATIENT_ARCHIVED, STALE_PATIENT_REVISION, REVISION_EXHAUSTED). Delete: RECORD_NOT_FOUND if missing, CROSS_PATIENT_WRITE if another patient's, STALE_REVISION if hash differs or 0 rows deleted; then increment patient revision (abort if not 1) and write a MEDICATION_DELETE/LAB_DELETE receipt. Restore: source delete receipt must exist with kind, patient, record and fingerprint matching (else RECORD_CONFLICT); record hash must equal sourceDelete.deletedContentHash (else INVALID_COMMAND); the delete receipt must be the latest for that record (new `dao.latestClinicalReceiptForRecord`) and the row must be absent (else RECORD_CONFLICT); then insert with revision committed+1, increment patient revision, write a RESTORE receipt. Retrying a delete/restore is idempotent through the existing receipt replay.
12	D607 DAO: `deleteMedication(id, patientId, expectedRevision)`, `deleteLabInvestigation(...)` (DELETE ... WHERE id AND patient_id AND revision), `latestClinicalReceiptForRecord(patientId, recordId)` (ORDER BY committed_patient_revision DESC LIMIT 1). No Room schema change, no migration, DB version stays.
13	D608 `AncState`: `deleteConfirmation: PendingDeletion(patientId, kind MED|LAB, recordId)?` and `undoOffer: UndoOffer(token, patientId, kind DELETE_MED|DELETE_LAB|SAVE_MED, label, phase READY|RUNNING)?`. No clinical payload in AncState.
14	D609 Events: RequestDeleteMedication(patientId, medicationId), RequestDeleteLab(patientId, labId), CancelDelete, ConfirmDelete, DeleteCommitted, DeleteFailed, UndoRequested(token), UndoCommitted, UndoFailed, UndoExpired(token). New SavedNotice values MEDICATION_DELETED, LAB_DELETED, MEDICATION_RESTORED, LAB_RESTORED, MEDICATION_SAVE_UNDONE.
15	D610 ViewModel keeps private `pendingUndo` (command + token) and `undoJob` (delay 8000 ms, then UndoExpired(token) clears both); lives in viewModelScope. Delete and undo run through the same `controller.execute(cmd, sessionEpoch)` as other clinical commands and never touch an editor's savePhase. Vault lock clears them (`clearFrozenCommands`).
16	D611 After a chained save (SubmitMedicationAndAddAnother) commits, publish an UndoOffer of kind SAVE_MED (label = medication name) whose undo is a DeleteMedicationCommand for that medicationId (expectedMedicationRevision = the receipt's committed revision, hash built from the saved fields). Undo targets only that medication.
17	D612 Edge rules: RequestDelete is ignored for archived patients, while an editor has unsaved changes or `savePhase.blocksEditing()`; ConfirmDelete with a clean editor open on the same record closes it. Undo uses the current patient revision at tap time and retries once after a fresh snapshot on STALE_PATIENT_REVISION. After UndoCommitted the blank chained medication draft (create draft, same patient) is rebased to the new patient revision; while an undo is RUNNING SubmitMedication* is ignored. A newer offer replaces and finalises the older one. A stale/unknown token is a no-op.
18	D613 Documented limits (state in the code comment of the repository branch): receipts store a fingerprint, not content, so nothing clinical remains after the window; backups taken before the delete still contain the row; attachments linked to a deleted lab become unlinked (UI must treat a missing link as unlinked).
19	
20	## Static checks (S300-S303, check_r6a.py)
21	S300 ClinicalCommands.kt defines the four commands and the four kinds; S301 RecordsDao has the three new queries; S302 AncState has the new events and fields and AncViewModel has an 8000 ms undo timer; S303 no schema version / migration file changed (RecordsDatabase version unchanged against HEAD) and no ui/ file changed.
22	
23	## Unit tests (src/test, independent author)
24	ClinicalCommandsTest: deleteMedicationCommandValidatesRevisionAndHash; restoreFingerprintBindsSourceDeleteAndPayload; contentHashIgnoresRevisionButCoversAllFields; the three lab twins.
25	AncDeleteUndoStateTest: requestDeleteIgnoredForArchivedPatient; requestDeleteIgnoredWhileDirtyDraftOrSaving; confirmDeleteClosesCleanEditorOnSameRecord; undoExpiredWithStaleTokenIsNoop; undoCommittedRebasesBlankChainedMedicationDraft; submitMedicationIgnoredWhileUndoRunning; lockResetClearsUndoOffer; newOfferReplacesOld.
26	ClinicalDeleteRuleTest (pure guard `ClinicalDeleteRule.evaluateRestore(receipt, latestReceipt, existingRow, cmd)` extracted into storage/): wrong kind, fingerprint mismatch, not latest, row already present, hash mismatch, success revision = tombstone+1.
27	Instrumented (emulator): delete and restore SQL on the real Room database for a medication and a lab.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""S300-S303 static check for round 6a (SPEC_LOGIC_R6.md). Stdlib only; textual contract only."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MAIN = ROOT / "app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative"
results = []


def record(name, ok, detail=""):
    results.append(ok)
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + " " + name + (": " + detail if detail and not ok else ""))


def read(path):
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError:
        return ""


def has_all(src, names):
    return [n for n in names if n not in src]


def main():
    cmds = read(MAIN / "storage/ClinicalCommands.kt")
    miss = has_all(cmds, ["DeleteMedicationCommand", "RestoreMedicationCommand", "DeleteLabInvestigationCommand",
                          "RestoreLabInvestigationCommand", "MEDICATION_DELETE", "MEDICATION_RESTORE", "LAB_DELETE",
                          "LAB_RESTORE", "medicationContentHash", "labContentHash"])
    record("S300 delete and restore commands, kinds and hashes defined", not miss, "missing " + ", ".join(miss))
    dao = read(MAIN / "storage/RecordsDao.kt")
    miss = has_all(dao, ["deleteMedication", "deleteLabInvestigation", "latestClinicalReceiptForRecord"])
    record("S301 DAO delete and latest-receipt queries present", not miss, "missing " + ", ".join(miss))
    st = read(MAIN / "state/AncState.kt") + read(MAIN / "state/AncViewModel.kt")
    miss = has_all(st, ["RequestDeleteMedication", "RequestDeleteLab", "ConfirmDelete", "UndoRequested", "UndoExpired",
                        "undoOffer", "deleteConfirmation", "8_000"])
    record("S302 delete/undo events, state fields and 8 s timer present", not miss, "missing " + ", ".join(miss))
    problems = []
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        for line in out.splitlines():
            if "/ancnative/ui/" in line or re.search(r"RecordsMigration|schemas/", line):
                problems.append("forbidden file changed: " + line)
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
        problems.append("git diff failed: " + str(exc))
    db = read(MAIN / "storage/RecordsDatabase.kt")
    record("S303 no ui, schema or migration file changed", not problems and "version" in db, "; ".join(problems))
    sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)

data class SaveDatingCommand(
    override val editorSessionId: String = "",
    override val operationUuid: String,
    override val patientId: String,
    override val expectedPatientRevision: Long,
    val lmpDate: String? = null,
    val ultrasoundEdd: String? = null,
    val agreedEdd: String? = null,
    val datingMethod: String? = null,
    val notes: String? = null,
    val transferDate: String? = null,
    val embryoAgeDays: Int? = null,
) : ClinicalCommand {
    override val recordKind = ClinicalRecordKind.DATING
    override val recordId = patientId

    override fun destination(): AncRoute = AncRoute.Workspace(patientId, WorkspaceSection.DATING)
    override fun savedNotice(): SavedNotice = SavedNotice.DATING

    override fun isStructurallyValid(): Boolean {
        if (!isValidUuid(operationUuid) || patientId.isBlank() || expectedPatientRevision < 1) return false
        if (!ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(lmpDate)) return false
        if (!ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(ultrasoundEdd)) return false
        if (!ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(agreedEdd)) return false
        if (!ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(transferDate)) return false
        if (datingMethod != null && datingMethod !in ClinicalVocabulary.datingMethods) return false
        if (embryoAgeDays != null && embryoAgeDays !in ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges) return false
        if (datingMethod == "IVF_TRANSFER" && (transferDate == null || embryoAgeDays !in ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges)) return false
        return true
    }

    override fun computeFingerprint(): String = sha256(
        "DATING|$operationUuid|$patientId|$expectedPatientRevision|$lmpDate|$ultrasoundEdd|$agreedEdd|$datingMethod|$notes|$transferDate|$embryoAgeDays",
    )

    companion object {
        fun prepare(state: AncState, operationUuid: String): ClinicalCommandPreparation {
            val draft = state.datingDraft
                ?: return ClinicalCommandPreparation.Rejected(setOf(ClinicalValidationError.SAVE_FAILED))
            val errors = mutableSetOf<ClinicalValidationError>()
            val lmp = draft.values.lmpDate.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            val usEdd = draft.values.ultrasoundEdd.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            val agreedEdd = draft.values.agreedEdd.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            val method = draft.values.datingMethod.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            val transfer = draft.values.transferDate.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            val embryoAge = draft.values.embryoAgeDays.trim().toIntOrNull()
            val notes = draft.values.notes.trim().ifEmpty { null }

            if (lmp != null && !ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(lmp)) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_DATE)
            if (usEdd != null && !ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(usEdd)) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_DATE)
            if (agreedEdd != null && !ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(agreedEdd)) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_DATE)
            if (transfer != null && !ClinicalVocabulary.isValidIsoDate(transfer)) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_DATE)
            if (method != null && method !in ClinicalVocabulary.datingMethods) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_METHOD)
            if (embryoAge != null && embryoAge !in ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            if (method == "IVF_TRANSFER") {
                if (transfer == null) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.REQUIRED_DATE)
                if (embryoAge == null || embryoAge !in ClinicalVocabulary.embryoAges) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            }

            if (errors.isNotEmpty()) return ClinicalCommandPreparation.Rejected(errors)

            val command = SaveDatingCommand(
                editorSessionId = draft.editorSessionId,
                operationUuid = operationUuid,
                patientId = draft.patientId,
                expectedPatientRevision = draft.basePatientRevision,
                lmpDate = lmp,
                ultrasoundEdd = usEdd,
                agreedEdd = agreedEdd,
                datingMethod = method,
                transferDate = transfer,
                embryoAgeDays = embryoAge,
                notes = notes,
            )
            return ClinicalCommandPreparation.Ready(command)
        }
    }
}

        if (gaDays != null && gaDays !in 0..6) return false
        if (fetalNumber != null && fetalNumber !in ClinicalVocabulary.fetalNumbers) return false
        if (presentation != null && presentation !in ClinicalVocabulary.fetalPresentations) return false
        if (placentalSite != null && placentalSite !in ClinicalVocabulary.placentalSites) return false
        if (amnioticFluid != null && amnioticFluid !in ClinicalVocabulary.amnioticFluids) return false
        return true
    }

        "US|$operationUuid|$patientId|$expectedPatientRevision|$scanId|$expectedScanRevision|$date|$gaWeeks|$gaDays|$fetalNumber|$presentation|$placentalSite|$amnioticFluid|$fetalHeartRate|$biometryBpd|$biometryHc|$biometryAc|$biometryFl|$estimatedFetalWeight|$impression|$linkedVisitId|${imageUris.joinToString(",")}",

                errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_DATE)
            }

                draft.values.gaWeeks.trim().toIntOrNull()?.also {
                    if (it !in 0..45) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_GA_WEEKS)
                } ?: run {
                    errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_GA_WEEKS)
                    null
                }
            }

            val gaDays = if (draft.values.gaDays.isBlank()) null else {
                draft.values.gaDays.trim().toIntOrNull()?.also {
                    if (it !in 0..6) errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_GA_DAYS)
                } ?: run {
                    errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_GA_DAYS)
                    null
                }
            }

            val fetalNumber = draft.values.fetalNumber.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            if (fetalNumber != null && fetalNumber !in ClinicalVocabulary.fetalNumbers) {
                errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            }

            val presentation = draft.values.presentation.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            if (presentation != null && presentation !in ClinicalVocabulary.fetalPresentations) {
                errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            }

            val placentalSite = draft.values.placentalSite.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            if (placentalSite != null && placentalSite !in ClinicalVocabulary.placentalSites) {
                errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            }

            val amnioticFluid = draft.values.amnioticFluid.trim().ifEmpty { null }
            if (amnioticFluid != null && amnioticFluid !in ClinicalVocabulary.amnioticFluids) {
                errors.add(ClinicalValidationError.INVALID_VOCABULARY)
            }

            if (errors.isNotEmpty()) return ClinicalCommandPreparation.Rejected(errors)

            val command = SaveUltrasoundScanCommand(
                editorSessionId = draft.editorSessionId,
                operationUuid = operationUuid,
                patientId = draft.patientId,
                expectedPatientRevision = draft.basePatientRevision,
                scanId = scanId,
                expectedScanRevision = draft.baseScanRevision,
                date = date,
                gaWeeks = gaWeeks,
                gaDays = gaDays,
                fetalNumber = fetalNumber,
                presentation = presentation,
                placentalSite = placentalSite,
                amnioticFluid = amnioticFluid,
                fetalHeartRate = draft.values.fetalHeartRate.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                biometryBpd = draft.values.biometryBpd.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                biometryHc = draft.values.biometryHc.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                biometryAc = draft.values.biometryAc.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                biometryFl = draft.values.biometryFl.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                estimatedFetalWeight = draft.values.estimatedFetalWeight.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                impression = draft.values.impression.trim().ifEmpty { null },
                linkedVisitId = draft.values.linkedVisitId.trim().ifEmpty { null },

            )
            return ClinicalCommandPreparation.Ready(command)
        }

class MedicationStatusDraftTest {
    private fun med(status: String, isNonCompliant: Boolean, isProphylaxis: Boolean = false) = DemoMedicationRecord(
        id = "m1", patientId = "p1", name = "Iron", dosage = "100 mg", route = "Oral",
        frequency = "Once daily", startDate = "2026-01-01", endDate = null, status = status,
        notes = null, isProphylaxis = isProphylaxis, isNonCompliant = isNonCompliant,
    )

    private fun patient(vararg meds: DemoMedicationRecord) = DemoPatient(
        id = "p1", caseId = "P1", displayName = "Patient One", dateOfBirth = "1995-01-01",
        phone = "01000000000", visits = emptyList(), status = "active", medications = meds.toList(),
    )

    private fun editing(record: DemoMedicationRecord): AncState {
        val state = AncState(patients = listOf(patient(record)), vaultState = VaultState.Unlocked(1L))
        return AncReducer.reduce(state, AncEvent.StartMedicationEditor("p1", "m1", "m1", "session-1"))
    }

    private fun setStatus(state: AncState, value: String) =
        AncReducer.reduce(state, AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged(MedicationDraftField.STATUS, value))

    private fun values(state: AncState) = state.medicationDraft!!.values

    private fun prepared(state: AncState): SaveMedicationCommand {
        val result = SaveMedicationCommand.prepare(state, "op-1", "m1")
        assertTrue(result is ClinicalCommandPreparation.Ready)
        return (result as ClinicalCommandPreparation.Ready).command as SaveMedicationCommand
    }

    @Test
    fun changingStatusToNonCompliantSetsFlagAndBackToActiveClearsIt() {
        var state = editing(med("Active", false))
        state = setStatus(state, MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT)
        assertEquals(MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT, values(state).status)
        assertTrue(values(state).isNonCompliant)
        state = setStatus(state, "Active")
        assertEquals("Active", values(state).status)
        assertFalse(values(state).isNonCompliant)
    }

    @Test
    fun otherStatusesClearTheFlag() {
        var state = setStatus(editing(med("Active", false)), MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT)
        state = setStatus(state, "Completed")
        assertFalse(values(state).isNonCompliant)
        state = setStatus(setStatus(state, MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT), "Discontinued")
        assertFalse(values(state).isNonCompliant)
    }

object AncReducer {
    fun reduce(state: AncState, event: AncEvent): AncState {
        val next = reduceInternal(state, event)
        val prompt = next.draftRecoveryPrompt
        return if (prompt != null && activeEditorSessionId(next) != prompt.editorSessionId) {
            next.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
        } else {
            next
        }
    }

    private fun isValueChangeEvent(event: AncEvent): Boolean = when (event) {
        is AncEvent.DraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.PatientDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.HistoriesDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.StatusReasonChanged,
        is AncEvent.DatingDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.UltrasoundDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.LabDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.LabAbnormalChanged,
        is AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.ScanPhotoImported -> true
        else -> false
    }

    private fun reduceInternal(state: AncState, event: AncEvent): AncState {
        if (state.draftRecoveryPrompt != null && isValueChangeEvent(event)) {
            return state
        }
        return when (event) {
            is AncEvent.SearchChanged -> state.copy(searchQuery = event.query)
            AncEvent.ClearSearch -> state.copy(searchQuery = "")
            AncEvent.ShowNewPatientInfo -> state.copy(showNewPatientInfo = true)
            AncEvent.HideNewPatientInfo -> state.copy(showNewPatientInfo = false)
            is AncEvent.OpenWorkspace -> navigate(state, AncRoute.Workspace(event.patientId))
            is AncEvent.OpenProfile -> navigate(state, AncRoute.Profile(event.patientId))
            is AncEvent.SelectSection -> {
                val route = state.route as? AncRoute.Workspace
                if (route == null) state else state.copy(route = route.copy(section = event.section), savedNotice = false, notice = null)
            }
            is AncEvent.StartVisit -> startVisit(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartPatientEditor -> startPatientEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartHistoriesEditor -> startHistoriesEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartPregnancyEditor -> startPregnancyEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartStatusEditor -> startStatusEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartDatingEditor -> startDatingEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartUltrasoundEditor -> startUltrasoundEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartLabEditor -> startLabEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartMedicationEditor -> startMedicationEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.DraftChanged -> updateDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.PatientDraftChanged -> updatePatientDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.HistoriesDraftChanged -> updateHistoriesDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged -> updatePregnancyDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.DatingDraftChanged -> updateDatingDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.UltrasoundDraftChanged -> updateUltrasoundDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.LabDraftChanged -> updateLabDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.LabAbnormalChanged -> updateLabAbnormal(state, event.isAbnormal)
            is AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged -> updateMedicationDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StatusReasonChanged -> state.copy(
                statusDraft = state.statusDraft?.copy(reason = event.value, errors = emptySet()),
                savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                saveError = null,
            )
            AncEvent.SubmitPatientProfile,
            AncEvent.SubmitOtherHistories,
            AncEvent.SubmitPreviousPregnancy,
            AncEvent.SubmitPatientStatus,
            AncEvent.SubmitDating,
            AncEvent.SubmitUltrasound,
            AncEvent.SubmitLab,
            AncEvent.SubmitLabAndAddAnother,
            AncEvent.SubmitMedication,
            AncEvent.SubmitMedicationAndAddAnother,
            -> state
            is AncEvent.SaveValidationFailed -> state.copy(
                draft = state.draft?.copy(errors = event.errors),
                savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                saveError = null,
            )
            is AncEvent.ClinicalValidationFailed -> when (event.recordKind) {
                ClinicalRecordKind.DATING -> state.copy(datingDraft = state.datingDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.ULTRASOUND_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.ULTRASOUND_UPDATE -> state.copy(ultrasoundDraft = state.ultrasoundDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.LAB_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.LAB_UPDATE -> state.copy(labDraft = state.labDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.MEDICATION_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.MEDICATION_UPDATE -> state.copy(medicationDraft = state.medicationDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
            }
            is AncEvent.PatientValidationFailed -> validationFailed(state, event)
            is AncEvent.SaveStarted -> if (state.canAccept(event.token)) {
                state.copy(
                    savePhase = SavePhase.PENDING,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = event.token,
                    savedNotice = false,
                    notice = null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveReconciling -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.copy(savePhase = SavePhase.RECONCILING, saveError = null)
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveFailed -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.copy(
                    savePhase = if (event.unresolved) SavePhase.UNRESOLVED else SavePhase.ERROR,
                    saveError = event.error,
                    pendingSave = if (event.unresolved) event.token else null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveCommitted -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.clearDrafts().copy(
                    patients = event.patients,
                    route = AncRoute.Workspace(event.patientId, WorkspaceSection.VISITS),
                    savedNotice = true,
                    notice = SavedNotice.VISIT,
                    savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.RecordCommitted -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.clearDrafts().copy(
                    patients = event.patients,
                    route = event.destination,
                    savedNotice = true,
                    notice = event.notice,
                    savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = null,
                )
            } else state
            AncEvent.CancelEditor, AncEvent.Back -> requestBack(state)
            AncEvent.ConfirmDiscard -> confirmDiscard(state)
            AncEvent.KeepEditing -> state.copy(showDiscardDialog = false, pendingAction = null)
            AncEvent.DismissNotice -> state.copy(savedNotice = false, notice = null)
            is AncEvent.AddAttachment, is AncEvent.DeleteAttachment, is AncEvent.ImportScanPhoto -> state
            is AncEvent.ScanPhotoImported -> {
                val draft = state.ultrasoundDraft
                if (draft == null || draft.patientId != event.patientId) state
                else state.copy(
                    ultrasoundDraft = draft.copy(
                        values = draft.values.copy(imageUris = (draft.values.imageUris + event.ref).distinct()),
                    ),
                )
            }
            is AncEvent.AttachmentFailed -> state.copy(attachmentError = event.error)
            AncEvent.DismissAttachmentError -> state.copy(attachmentError = null)
            is AncEvent.DraftRecoveryFound -> {
                if (state.draftRecoveryPrompt == null && activeEditorSessionId(state) == event.prompt.editorSessionId) {
                    state.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = event.prompt)
                } else {
                    state
                }
            }
            AncEvent.AcceptDraftRecovery -> {
                val prompt = state.draftRecoveryPrompt ?: return state
                applyDraftRecord(state, prompt.record).copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
            }
            AncEvent.DiscardDraftRecovery -> state.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
        }
    }

    private fun navigate(state: AncState, destination: AncRoute): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
            LabDraftField.LAB_NAME -> draft.values.copy(labName = event.value)
        }
        return state.copy(labDraft = draft.copy(values = values, errors = emptySet()), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
    }

    private fun updateLabAbnormal(state: AncState, isAbnormal: Boolean): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val draft = state.labDraft ?: return state
        return state.copy(
            labDraft = draft.copy(values = draft.values.copy(isAbnormal = isAbnormal), errors = emptySet()),
            savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
            saveError = null,
        )
    }

    private fun updateMedicationDraft(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val draft = state.medicationDraft ?: return state
        val values = when (event.field) {
            MedicationDraftField.NAME -> draft.values.copy(name = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.DOSAGE -> draft.values.copy(dosage = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.ROUTE -> draft.values.copy(route = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.FREQUENCY -> draft.values.copy(frequency = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.START_DATE -> draft.values.copy(startDate = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.END_DATE -> draft.values.copy(endDate = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.STATUS -> draft.values.copy(
                status = event.value.ifBlank { MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE },
                isNonCompliant = (event.value == MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT),
            )
            MedicationDraftField.NOTES -> draft.values.copy(notes = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.ADVERSE_NOTES -> draft.values.copy(adverseNotes = event.value)
        }
        return state.copy(medicationDraft = draft.copy(values = values, errors = emptySet()), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
    }

    private fun validationFailed(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.PatientValidationFailed): AncState = when (event.editor) {
        PatientEditorKind.PROFILE -> state.copy(patientDraft = state.patientDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.HISTORIES -> state.copy(historiesDraft = state.historiesDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.PREGNANCY -> state.copy(pregnancyDraft = state.pregnancyDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.STATUS -> state.copy(statusDraft = state.statusDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
    }.copy(savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)

    private fun requestBack(state: AncState): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val destination = when (val route = state.route) {
            AncRoute.PatientList -> return state
            startDate = startDate,
            endDate = endDate.orEmpty(),
            status = effStatus.ifBlank { MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE },
            isProphylaxis = isProphylaxis,
            notes = notes.orEmpty(),
            isNonCompliant = (effStatus == MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT),
            adverseNotes = adverseNotes.orEmpty(),
        )
    }

    private fun AncState.canAccept(token: PendingSaveToken): Boolean =
        (savePhase == SavePhase.IDLE || savePhase == SavePhase.ERROR) && activeEditorSessionId(this) == token.editorSessionId

    private fun SavePhase.blocksEditing(): Boolean =
        this == SavePhase.PENDING || this == SavePhase.RECONCILING || this == SavePhase.UNRESOLVED
}

object AncReducer {
    fun reduce(state: AncState, event: AncEvent): AncState {
        val next = reduceInternal(state, event)
        val prompt = next.draftRecoveryPrompt
        return if (prompt != null && activeEditorSessionId(next) != prompt.editorSessionId) {
            next.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
        } else {
            next
        }
    }

    private fun isValueChangeEvent(event: AncEvent): Boolean = when (event) {
        is AncEvent.DraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.PatientDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.HistoriesDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.StatusReasonChanged,
        is AncEvent.DatingDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.UltrasoundDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.LabDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.LabAbnormalChanged,
        is AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged,
        is AncEvent.ScanPhotoImported -> true
        else -> false
    }

    private fun reduceInternal(state: AncState, event: AncEvent): AncState {
        if (state.draftRecoveryPrompt != null && isValueChangeEvent(event)) {
            return state
        }
        return when (event) {
            is AncEvent.SearchChanged -> state.copy(searchQuery = event.query)
            AncEvent.ClearSearch -> state.copy(searchQuery = "")
            AncEvent.ShowNewPatientInfo -> state.copy(showNewPatientInfo = true)
            AncEvent.HideNewPatientInfo -> state.copy(showNewPatientInfo = false)
            is AncEvent.OpenWorkspace -> navigate(state, AncRoute.Workspace(event.patientId))
            is AncEvent.OpenProfile -> navigate(state, AncRoute.Profile(event.patientId))
            is AncEvent.SelectSection -> {
                val route = state.route as? AncRoute.Workspace
                if (route == null) state else state.copy(route = route.copy(section = event.section), savedNotice = false, notice = null)
            }
            is AncEvent.StartVisit -> startVisit(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartPatientEditor -> startPatientEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartHistoriesEditor -> startHistoriesEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartPregnancyEditor -> startPregnancyEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartStatusEditor -> startStatusEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartDatingEditor -> startDatingEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartUltrasoundEditor -> startUltrasoundEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartLabEditor -> startLabEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StartMedicationEditor -> startMedicationEditor(state, event)
            is AncEvent.DraftChanged -> updateDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.PatientDraftChanged -> updatePatientDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.HistoriesDraftChanged -> updateHistoriesDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.PregnancyDraftChanged -> updatePregnancyDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.DatingDraftChanged -> updateDatingDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.UltrasoundDraftChanged -> updateUltrasoundDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.LabDraftChanged -> updateLabDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.LabAbnormalChanged -> updateLabAbnormal(state, event.isAbnormal)
            is AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged -> updateMedicationDraft(state, event)
            is AncEvent.StatusReasonChanged -> state.copy(
                statusDraft = state.statusDraft?.copy(reason = event.value, errors = emptySet()),
                savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                saveError = null,
            )
            AncEvent.SubmitPatientProfile,
            AncEvent.SubmitOtherHistories,
            AncEvent.SubmitPreviousPregnancy,
            AncEvent.SubmitPatientStatus,
            AncEvent.SubmitDating,
            AncEvent.SubmitUltrasound,
            AncEvent.SubmitLab,
            AncEvent.SubmitLabAndAddAnother,
            AncEvent.SubmitMedication,
            AncEvent.SubmitMedicationAndAddAnother,
            -> state
            is AncEvent.SaveValidationFailed -> state.copy(
                draft = state.draft?.copy(errors = event.errors),
                savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                saveError = null,
            )
            is AncEvent.ClinicalValidationFailed -> when (event.recordKind) {
                ClinicalRecordKind.DATING -> state.copy(datingDraft = state.datingDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.ULTRASOUND_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.ULTRASOUND_UPDATE -> state.copy(ultrasoundDraft = state.ultrasoundDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.LAB_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.LAB_UPDATE -> state.copy(labDraft = state.labDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
                ClinicalRecordKind.MEDICATION_CREATE, ClinicalRecordKind.MEDICATION_UPDATE -> state.copy(medicationDraft = state.medicationDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
            }
            is AncEvent.PatientValidationFailed -> validationFailed(state, event)
            is AncEvent.SaveStarted -> if (state.canAccept(event.token)) {
                state.copy(
                    savePhase = SavePhase.PENDING,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = event.token,
                    savedNotice = false,
                    notice = null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveReconciling -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.copy(savePhase = SavePhase.RECONCILING, saveError = null)
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveFailed -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.copy(
                    savePhase = if (event.unresolved) SavePhase.UNRESOLVED else SavePhase.ERROR,
                    saveError = event.error,
                    pendingSave = if (event.unresolved) event.token else null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.SaveCommitted -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.clearDrafts().copy(
                    patients = event.patients,
                    route = AncRoute.Workspace(event.patientId, WorkspaceSection.VISITS),
                    savedNotice = true,
                    notice = SavedNotice.VISIT,
                    savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = null,
                )
            } else state
            is AncEvent.RecordCommitted -> if (state.pendingSave == event.token) {
                state.clearDrafts().copy(
                    patients = event.patients,
                    route = event.destination,
                    savedNotice = true,
                    notice = event.notice,
                    savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
                    saveError = null,
                    pendingSave = null,
                )
            } else state
            AncEvent.CancelEditor, AncEvent.Back -> requestBack(state)
            AncEvent.ConfirmDiscard -> confirmDiscard(state)
            AncEvent.KeepEditing -> state.copy(showDiscardDialog = false, pendingAction = null)
            AncEvent.DismissNotice -> state.copy(savedNotice = false, notice = null)
            is AncEvent.AddAttachment, is AncEvent.DeleteAttachment, is AncEvent.ImportScanPhoto -> state
            is AncEvent.ScanPhotoImported -> {
                val draft = state.ultrasoundDraft
                if (draft == null || draft.patientId != event.patientId) state
                else state.copy(
                    ultrasoundDraft = draft.copy(
                        values = draft.values.copy(imageUris = (draft.values.imageUris + event.ref).distinct()),
                    ),
                )
            }
            is AncEvent.AttachmentFailed -> state.copy(attachmentError = event.error)
            AncEvent.DismissAttachmentError -> state.copy(attachmentError = null)
            is AncEvent.DraftRecoveryFound -> {
                if (state.draftRecoveryPrompt == null && activeEditorSessionId(state) == event.prompt.editorSessionId) {
                    state.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = event.prompt)
                } else {
                    state
                }
            }
            AncEvent.AcceptDraftRecovery -> {
                val prompt = state.draftRecoveryPrompt ?: return state
                applyDraftRecord(state, prompt.record).copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
            }
            AncEvent.DiscardDraftRecovery -> state.copy(draftRecoveryPrompt = null)
        }
    }

    private fun navigate(state: AncState, destination: AncRoute): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
            LabDraftField.LAB_NAME -> draft.values.copy(labName = event.value)
        }
        return state.copy(labDraft = draft.copy(values = values, errors = emptySet()), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
    }

    private fun updateLabAbnormal(state: AncState, isAbnormal: Boolean): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val draft = state.labDraft ?: return state
        return state.copy(
            labDraft = draft.copy(values = draft.values.copy(isAbnormal = isAbnormal), errors = emptySet()),
            savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE,
            saveError = null,
        )
    }

    private fun updateMedicationDraft(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.MedicationDraftChanged): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val draft = state.medicationDraft ?: return state
        val values = when (event.field) {
            MedicationDraftField.NAME -> draft.values.copy(name = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.DOSAGE -> draft.values.copy(dosage = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.ROUTE -> draft.values.copy(route = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.FREQUENCY -> draft.values.copy(frequency = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.START_DATE -> draft.values.copy(startDate = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.END_DATE -> draft.values.copy(endDate = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.STATUS -> draft.values.copy(
                status = event.value.ifBlank { MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE },
                isNonCompliant = (event.value == MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT),
            )
            MedicationDraftField.NOTES -> draft.values.copy(notes = event.value)
            MedicationDraftField.ADVERSE_NOTES -> draft.values.copy(adverseNotes = event.value)
        }
        return state.copy(medicationDraft = draft.copy(values = values, errors = emptySet()), savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)
    }

    private fun validationFailed(state: AncState, event: AncEvent.PatientValidationFailed): AncState = when (event.editor) {
        PatientEditorKind.PROFILE -> state.copy(patientDraft = state.patientDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.HISTORIES -> state.copy(historiesDraft = state.historiesDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.PREGNANCY -> state.copy(pregnancyDraft = state.pregnancyDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
        PatientEditorKind.STATUS -> state.copy(statusDraft = state.statusDraft?.copy(errors = event.errors))
    }.copy(savePhase = SavePhase.IDLE, saveError = null)

    private fun requestBack(state: AncState): AncState {
        if (state.savePhase.blocksEditing()) return state
        val destination = when (val route = state.route) {
            AncRoute.PatientList -> return state
            startDate = startDate,
            endDate = endDate.orEmpty(),
            status = effStatus.ifBlank { MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE },
            isProphylaxis = isProphylaxis,
            notes = notes.orEmpty(),
            isNonCompliant = (effStatus == MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT),
            adverseNotes = adverseNotes.orEmpty(),
        )
    }

    private fun AncState.canAccept(token: PendingSaveToken): Boolean =
        (savePhase == SavePhase.IDLE || savePhase == SavePhase.ERROR) && activeEditorSessionId(this) == token.editorSessionId

    private fun SavePhase.blocksEditing(): Boolean =
        this == SavePhase.PENDING || this == SavePhase.RECONCILING || this == SavePhase.UNRESOLVED
}
